subject: reasoning
question:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Statement: The bank has introduced a rewards program for debit card users.

Conclusions:

I. More customers will start using debit cards.

II. Credit card usage may decline.
solution:
Given Statement:

The bank has introduced a rewards program for debit card users.

Conclusions:

I. More customers will start using debit cards - False (Because, although a rewards program may encourage usage, it is not definitely stated that more customers will start using debit cards. It can be possible only.)

II. Credit card usage may decline - False (Because, no information is given about credit card usage or its impact due to the rewards program. So it can be possible only.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
